description: This Java class 'ExpectationInitializerLoader' is responsible for loading and initializing expectations in the MockServer framework. It handles loading expectations from JSON files and from specified initializer classes, manages caching of file paths, and logs various stages of the process.

classes.name: ExpectationInitializerLoader
classes.description: Main class responsible for loading expectations from JSON files and initializer classes, managing caches, and logging activities.

methods.name: ExpectationInitializerLoader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the loader with configuration, logger, and request matchers, then loads expectations.

methods.name: expandedInitializationJsonPaths
methods.description: Expands file path globs into a list of file paths, with caching.

methods.name: addExpectationsFromInitializer
methods.description: Loads expectations from JSON files and initializer classes, adding them to request matchers.

methods.name: retrieveExpectationsFromInitializerClass
methods.description: Loads expectations from a specified initializer class via reflection.

methods.name: retrieveExpectationsFromFile
methods.description: Loads expectations from specified JSON files, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: loadExpectations
methods.description: Loads and combines expectations from initializer class and JSON files for testing.
